Name: Ore Vein Detector
Desc: Summons a detection radar, discovering 1 high-value item every certain amount of time.

Name: Full Combo
Desc: After successfully grabbing 3 items, scan and grab 1 item not electromagnetically linked. All grabbed items count as the same type.

Name: Close Encounter
Desc: Summons a UFO to grab the nearest item. All grabbed items count as the same type.

Name: Support Mode
Desc: The hook now shows aiming line and grabs all items on its path.

Name: Non-oriented Chain - 1
Desc: All points gained in the stage increase by 8%.

Name: Non-oriented Chain - 2
Desc: All points gained in the stage increase by 16%.

Name: Non-oriented Chain - 3
Desc: All points gained in the stage increase by 24%.

Name: Universal Converter
Desc: All grabbed items count as the same type for same-type point rewards.

Name: Speed Turbine - 1
Desc: Moderately increases grapple speed for each successful grab within the current map, up to 3 times.

Name: Speed Turbine - 2
Desc: Moderately increases grapple speed for each successful grab within the current map, up to 6 times.

Name: Speed Turbine - 3
Desc: Moderately increases grapple speed for each successful grab within the current map, up to 9 times.

Name: Collab Grappling Hook
Desc: Expands into 3 collab grappling hooks, each grabbing items independently.

Name: Collab Grappling Hook - Upgrade
Desc: Expands into 5 collab grappling hooks, each grabbing items independently.

Name: Collab Grappling Hook - Upgrade
Desc: Collab grappling hook can bounce off edges once, while gaining a significant speed boost.

Name: Grappling Speed Up - 1
Desc: Grappling hook's speed slightly increases.

Name: Grappling Speed Up - 2
Desc: Grappling hook's speed moderately increases.

Name: Grappling Speed Up - 3
Desc: Grappling hook's speed greatly increases.

Name: Grappling Hook Size Up - 1
Desc: Grappling hook's size slightly increases.

Name: Grappling Hook Size Up - 2
Desc: Grappling hook's size moderately increases.

Name: Grappling Hook Size Up - 3
Desc: Grappling hook's size greatly increases.

Name: Let's Discuss the Price - 1
Desc: Resource Points earned fluctuate between -6% and +12%

Name: Let's Discuss the Price - 2
Desc: Resource Points earned fluctuate between -12% and +24%.

Name: Let's Discuss the Price - 3
Desc: Resource Points earned fluctuate between -18% and +36%.

Name: Time Extension - 1
Desc: Start with 10s of extra stage time.

Name: Time Extension - 2
Desc: Start with 20s of extra stage time.

Name: Time Extension - 3
Desc: Start with 30s of extra stage time.

Name: Electromagnetic Chain Module
Desc: Links 1 item at the top with 2 items at the bottom every 7s. Grab any linked item to grab all of them.

Name: Electromagnetic Chain Module - Upgrade
Desc: Connects 5 items instead.

Name: Electromagnetic Chain Module - Upgrade
Desc: Connection interval reduces to 3s.

Name: Net-Shooting Grappling Hook
Desc: The grapple becomes a net! Fire once to enter aiming mode, then fire again to deploy the net and grab all items in the area.

Name: Net-Shooting Grappling Hook - Upgrade 1
Desc: The size of the net is greatly increased.

Name: Net-Shooting Grappling Hook - Upgrade 2
Desc: Grappled item weight becomes the weight of the lightest grappled item.

Name: Copycat Module
Desc: Increase all item values by 25%. Upon grabbing specific items, there's a 60% chance to create a duplicate where the original was grabbed.

Name: Copycat Module - Upgrade
Desc: The chance of creating a duplicate increases to 100%.

Name: Copycat Module - Upgrade
Desc: Generate rarer items when duplicated.

Name: UFO Speed Up - 1
Desc: UFO's movement speed slightly increases.

Name: UFO Speed Up - 2
Desc: UFO's movement speed moderately increases.

Name: UFO Speed Up - 3
Desc: UFO's movement speed significantly increases.
